Future envelope final script

1) *Frequency vs magnitude*
Is GPP more sensitive to increases in frequency of VPD extremes or magnitude of VPD extremes?

15, 30 and 50% increase in number of days above 90th percentile in the summer (Extreme VPD events become more common)

15, 30 and 50% increase in magnitude of the 90th percentile VPD extremes (Extremes get more intense)

Then both?

2) *Baseline and extremes*

Sort into tropical, arid and temperate
Tropical (+0.524 kPa), Arid (+0.644 kPa) and Temperate (+0.344 Kpa) increase (Fang et al., 2022)

Biome-specific background increases, accounts for the fact that arid systems will face larger increases in VPD stress than temperate ones.
Make sure site biome assignment is unambiguous
Clearly state you are applying a uniform shift to every daily value in the whole dataset

Background rising VPD for each
Both +28% magnitude and rising VPD for each (Zhou et al., 2019)
